senseIssues.title: No telemetry and stuck pending until reboot after the November Sense update
senseIssues.scope: Reported on Windows devices. Server scope not confirmed.
senseIssues.symptom: After the November 2026 Sense upgrade a device stops sending telemetry and shows as pending in the Defender portal until it is restarted.
senseIssues.workaround: Restart the device. Microsoft documents a restart for SENSE events 85 and 100. To roll back the sensor: MpCmdRun.exe -RevertEdr -ToVersion Previous (needs a restart).
senseIssues.stageNote: Admin-observed, carried over from the Grok build. Microsoft is reported to be aware through a support case; no public acknowledgment found.

senseIssues.title: KB5005292 install error 0x800700aa
senseIssues.symptom: The KB5005292 Sense package fails to install with error 0x800700aa. This is an install failure, not the telemetry problem above.
senseIssues.stageNote: Microsoft Q&A thread (11 Nov 2026) and WindowsDigitals (18 Nov 2026), carried over from the Grok build. No Microsoft acknowledgment found.
